findings.description: The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without explicit SSE settings, including the seeded vendor roster, may be stored without encryption at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL does not encrypt the ledger data stored in the bucket.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Versioning and access logging do not ensure that model artifacts are encrypted at rest.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration. Private access and versioning do not protect runbook contents from unencrypted storage.
This uploaded vendor-roster object does not specify server-side encryption, and its destination bucket has no default encryption configuration. The object may therefore be stored unencrypted at rest.
